_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — placeholder values showing the shape. Every number must come from research for the actual variety and for Pasadena (USDA 10b). Set profile.succession to {everyDays, notes} only for crops that are used up and resown (cilantro, dill, green onions); null otherwise. Fill profile.harvest for anything picked more than once. Delete _comment before adding.
name: Tomato

profile.summary: One or two sentences on what this plant needs to do well here.

steps: Soak seeds 12 hours in room-temperature water.

profile.sowing: 1/4 in deep, 2 seeds per cell, heat mat at 75-80°F.

germination.notes: Keep evenly moist; remove dome at first sprouts.

profile.harvestNotes: Pick when fully coloured and slightly soft.

steps: Twist or snip the fruit off with its green cap.
harvest.replaceWhen: Pull the plant when new growth stops setting fruit.

fertilizer.label: Side-dress
fertilizer.notes: Stop high-nitrogen feeds once fruit sets.

profile.water: Deep watering 2-3x/week; daily in heat waves.
profile.spacing: 24 in apart, cage or stake at planting.
